settings.definition_quote: Assume the actions lie in $\MD\subset \real^d$ and for any $x\in \MD$, $\norm{x}^2\leq L$. Assume the reward of taking action $x\in \MD$ has the form of $$h_t(x)=\theta_*\ttop x + \eta_t$$ and assume $\forall x\in \MD,\, \theta_*\ttop x \in [-1,1]$.

source.label: thm:UCBImp
source.quote: With probability at least $1-\delta$, the total regret of the UCB($\delta$) algorithm with the action selection rule~\eqref{eq:actSelFinite} is constant and is bounded by $$R(T) \leq \sum_{i: \Delta_i >0} \left( 3 \Delta_i + \frac{16}{\Delta_i} \log \frac{2K}{\Delta_i \delta} \right).$$

results.notes: Regret R(T)=sum Delta_i N_{i,T} (random pull counts). Theorem numbering inferred from shared counter.

bound.expression_latex: 4 \sqrt{T d \log (\lambda + T L /d)} \left( \lambda^{1/2} S + R \sqrt{2\log 1/\delta + d \log( 1+ T L/(\lambda d) )} \right)

symbols.L_feat: bound on squared action norm: ||x||^2 <= L

source.label: thm:ConfEllpImp
source.quote: With probability at least $1-\delta$, the regret of the Linear Bandit Algorithm shown in Table~\ref{alg:LinBandit} satisfies $$\forall T\geq 1,\quad R(T) \leq 4 \sqrt{T d \log (\lambda + T L /d)} \left( \lambda^{1/2} S + R \sqrt{2\log 1/\delta + d \log( 1+ T L/(\lambda d) )} \right).$$

results.notes: Action selection is NP-hard in general (per paper), so compute not stated as polynomial. Theorem number inferred.

bound.expression_latex: R(T) \leq 4 \sqrt{2T d \log (\lambda + T L /d)} \left( \lambda^{1/2} S + R \sqrt{2\log 1/\delta + d \log( 1+T L/(\lambda d) )} \right)+ 4\sqrt{d\log(T/d)}

symbols.L_feat: bound on squared action norm: ||x||^2 <= L

source.label: thm:ConfEllpEff
source.quote: With probability at least $1-\delta$, $\forall T\geq 1$, the regret of the Linear Bandit Algorithm shown in Table~\ref{alg:LinBanditFixAct} satisfies R(T) \leq 4 \sqrt{2T d \log (\lambda + T L /d)} \left( \lambda^{1/2} S + R \sqrt{2\log 1/\delta + d \log( 1+T L/(\lambda d) )} \right)+ 4\sqrt{d\log(T/d)}.

results.notes: Proof's final line omits the additive 4sqrt(d log(T/d)) term; recorded theorem statement. Algorithm only recomputes the optimistic action O(log t) times.

source.label: thm:ConfEllpDeltaImp
source.quote: Assume that $\Delta>0$ for the gap $\Delta$ defined in~\citep{DaniStoch}. Further assume that $\lambda \geq 1$ and $S\geq 1$. With probability at least $1-\delta$, $\forall T\geq 1$, the regret of the algorithm shown in Table~\ref{alg:LinBandit} satisfies $$R(T)=\frac{16 R^2 \lambda S^2}{\Delta} \left(\log (L T) + ...\right)^2.$$

results.notes: Theorem written with '=' but is an upper bound. Proof has constant inconsistencies (64 vs 16). Theorem number inferred.
